decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical DOS interrupt vector definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS MSINIT includes the file and uses int_fatal_abort, addr_int_command and addr_int_terminate.
Review 090 compares the MSINIT module with its inferred target range and classifies differing bytes as relocatable fields.
A targeted lexical search found no NT/BOP markers.
limitations: The MSINIT comparison supports only exercised definitions and an inferred module alignment; alternative vector configuration, relocation values and final binary identity remain unverified.
